## Contribution category

- [ ] Presentation-only
- [ ] Brogue bridge/parity
- [ ] Parity-preserving maintenance, build, tests, or documentation

## Problem and scope

Describe the defect or missing Brogue behavior and the focused solution.

## Authority analysis

State whether Brogue CE or UZDoom owns the behavior. For bridge work, name the
existing Brogue entry points used.

## Gameplay declaration

- [ ] No gameplay outcome is added or changed; Brogue CE remains authoritative.

Explain any uncertainty before requesting review.

## Verification

List exact commands, seeds, action sequences, hashes, package checks, and
runtime smoke tests performed.

## Visual evidence

Attach before/after captures for visible changes, or write `Not applicable`.

## Asset and license provenance

List author, source URL, license, modifications, and redistribution terms for
every new asset, or write `No new assets`.

## Known limitations

List intentionally incomplete work and unrun verification gates.

- [ ] I read and followed `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
